next.reason: 1985: EXIT PROGRAM in a non-initial called program 'causes execution to continue with the next executable statement following the CALL', caller state unaltered save shared data/files, called state unaltered but PERFORM ranges ended. 2023 routes it to GOBACK (§2023:14.9.14.4 GR3); §2023:14.9.18.4 GR2 keeps the return and 'The state of the calling runtime element is not altered', §2023:13.5.4 GR1 keeps static data. But the 2023 EXIT PROGRAM accepts a RAISING phrase: §2023:14.9.18.4 GR1 b) 'If the RAISING phrase is specified, an exception condition is raised in the activating runtime element', and a) a non-COBOL activator continues 'in an implementor-defined fashion'. A case added to this statement's effect.
